extraction.name: LUMA
extraction.description: A multimodal dataset, featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, specifically designed for learning from uncertain data. It extends the well-known CIFAR 10/100 dataset with audio samples extracted from three audio corpora, and text data generated using the Gemma-7B Large Language Model (LLM).
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, Sébastien Foumier
extraction.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Foumier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Leaming from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th Intemational ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR ’25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were compiled from the CIFAR-100 and CIFAR-10 datasets. Audio samples were extracted from The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, and Mozilla Common Voice corpora, plus 73 voluntary contributions. Text data was generated using the Gemma-7B Instruct model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10, The Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, Mozilla Common Voice, Gemma-7B Instruct
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The Python toolkit allows the injection of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties in a controlled and parameterized way into each modality, including adding noise, reducing diversity, and injecting OOD samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio segments were extracted using forced alignments. Audio samples were validated automatically using Whisper Large V3 and manually using Label Studio. Text samples were validated by masking labels and classifying with Gemma-7B. Images were selected from CIFAR datasets based on class availability (600 samples threshold).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Manual validation of audio samples involved checking if the audio said the class label (or plural). Annotators answered 'Yes' or 'No' to the prompt 'Is the audio saying the word below? (An extra 's' or 'es' in the pronunciation is okay.)'. Samples with conflicting annotations were rejected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: 2 annotations per sample were collected. 71.61% annotation agreement was achieved. Samples where both annotators confirmed validity were accepted; samples with conflicting annotations were rejected.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Colleagues (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI’s Whisper Large V3 model, Gemma-7B Instruct model, Montreal Forced Aligner
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The open-source nature of the data compilation pipeline and code for uncertainty and noise generation facilitates the integration of new contributions from the community.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: 73 additional recordings were voluntarily contributed by colleagues, which were anonymized.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended to help the research community design more trustworthy and robust machine learning approaches for safety critical applications.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The text modality contains samples with offensive biases and stereotypes, particularly gender bias for classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', and 'girl'. Prompts were reconstructed to minimize bias, but a significant amount of bias still exists.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may contain factual inaccuracies or biases due to LLM generation. Audio data may contain misaligned segments or noisy samples. LUMA shall not be used as a source of knowledge or information.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking multimodal learning algorithms on uncertain data, uncertainty quantification, OOD detection, Training, Testing
